pages.title: Bacteria: Life & Death
pages.creator: WiseOldMan
pages.description: Tend a colony of microbes in Bacteria: Life & Death. Balance food, warmth and water to help the bacteria multiply, and watch how the colony responds when you change its environment.

pages.title: Slide Block Puzzle
pages.creator: Depfov
pages.description: Slide colored blocks out of their boxes in Slide Block Puzzle. Take your time working out which piece needs to move first, then rearrange the rest to clear an exit.

pages.title: Pickle Ball Clash
pages.creator: Hyper Rabbit Games
pages.description: Step onto the pickleball court in Pickle Ball Clash. Work on where you place your returns, customize your player and try the paddles you unlock as you move up the ranks.

pages.title: Goods Triple Match 3D
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Pick identical objects off the table in Goods Triple Match 3D. Find three of each item and look beneath cleared pieces for more matches as you work through the pile.

pages.title: Capybara Skewer Match
pages.creator: Orenji Spark
pages.description: Help a capybara grill skewers in Capybara Skewer Match. Find matching ingredients among the skewers and work through the stall's supply before the time runs out.

pages.title: Tales of Lagoona
pages.creator: Mad Data
pages.description: Search underwater scenes for hidden objects in Tales of Lagoona. Sell what you find to raise money for the New Anemone Orphanage and help keep it open.

pages.title: Food Sort 3D
pages.creator: Ultra Games Entertainment Private limited
pages.description: Sort food items into their categories in Food Sort 3D. Work your way through eateries from casual fast-food counters to upscale restaurants as the items you need to organize change.

pages.title: Geometry Arrow 2
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Dodge hazards through six rhythm courses in Geometry Arrow 2. Switch between the Arrow and the Wheel and adjust your timing to the way each one moves.

pages.title: Ship Factory Tycoon
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Set up ship production lines in Ship Factory Tycoon. Automate work as the factory grows and use upgrades to increase how much you can produce across the operation.

pages.title: Purrfect Puzzle
pages.creator: BlackMoon Design
pages.description: Place and combine cat tiles in Purrfect Puzzle. Pay attention to their values and keep useful spaces open as you build more valuable cats and try to raise your score.

pages.title: Cage Busters: Slingshot Heroes
pages.creator: Dev Hub Games
pages.description: Use a slingshot to shoot balls into matching colored holes in Cage Busters: Slingshot Heroes. Work around obstacles and land the hits you need to free the animals inside.

pages.title: Boat Rush
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Drive a motorboat through water courses in Boat Rush. Pick up coins, use airborne spins to boost your speed and complete objectives to unlock boats with more power.

pages.title: X2 Solitaire Merge: 2048 Cards
pages.creator: Stonemobile Kft
pages.description: Combine cards of equal value in X2 Solitaire Merge: 2048 Cards. Think about where to play each card so that the resulting stacks leave room to build still higher numbers.

pages.title: Fill Up Block Logic Puzzle
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Place directional blocks on the grid in Fill Up Block Logic Puzzle. Use the directions marked on the pieces to decide where they belong and fill all the required spaces.

pages.title: Flying Wings HoverCraft
pages.description: Race futuristic hovercraft through a neon city in Flying Wings HoverCraft. Get used to steering the vehicles as you switch between modes and try different ways of taking on the course.

pages.title: Motorbike
pages.creator: Wolves Interactive
pages.description: Ride through traffic in Motorbike and try to keep your speed up as you find gaps between vehicles. Switch between races with opponents and an endless ride for different challenges.

pages.title: Mini Sticky
pages.creator: NoaDev
pages.description: Lead a little blob to a piece of candy in Mini Sticky. Use its ability to cling to the terrain to get around obstacles and slip past enemies.

pages.title: Delicious: Emily's New Beginning
pages.creator: Gamehouse
pages.description: Help Emily serve customers again in Delicious: Emily's New Beginning. Keep up with orders in the restaurant while making time to look after her daughter Paige during the shift.

pages.title: World Puzzle
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Rearrange pieces to restore a picture connected to the featured country in World Puzzle. Use details in the scene to find each piece's position and discover the full image.

pages.title: SmileyWorld Match
pages.creator: SmileyWorld
pages.description: Swap smileys and other items to make groups of three in SmileyWorld Match. Check the current mission and collect the pieces it asks for before moving on.

pages.title: Get My Outfit
pages.creator: BestGameSpot
pages.description: Pull pins to get clothes to the waiting character in Get My Outfit. Look at which barriers keep enemies out of the way, and plan the order of your moves through 60 puzzles.

pages.title: Eliza Winter Coronation
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Prepare Princess Eliza for her winter coronation in Eliza Winter Coronation. Choose makeup and a royal outfit that suits the season before she takes the throne.

pages.title: Sweet Crush
pages.creator: JM Neto Game Dev
pages.description: Line up matching candies in Sweet Crush to pop them and score points. Look for moves that set up another match and use power-ups to clear more of the board.

pages.title: Mr Speedy the Cat
pages.creator: Olivier Darmon
pages.description: Run through the streets and across rooftops with Mr Speedy the Cat. Time your jumps to carry the stray past obstacles and keep him moving for as long as you can.

pages.title: Dropz!
pages.creator: Absolutist Ltd.
pages.description: Pop the largest drops on the board in Dropz! Watch how clearing one drop changes the surrounding pieces and look for groups of pops that can produce bonus drops.

pages.title: Fall Cars Ultimate Knockout Race
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Race a car across 3D obstacle courses in Fall Cars Ultimate Knockout Race. Watch where the path narrows and try to beat the other cars to the finish across ten sections.

pages.title: Fast Tennis
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Return shots into the other side of the court in Fast Tennis. Vary the spin to make the ball harder to read, and be the first to reach ten points.

pages.title: Super MadRex
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Aim and launch a small character toward the portal in Super MadRex. Judge where each throw will carry it and avoid the hazards as you work through the platforming levels.

pages.title: Solitaire Story TriPeaks
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Clear cards one rank above or below the open card in Solitaire Story TriPeaks. Play through different layouts to visit distant places, with new landmarks and landscapes along the route.

pages.title: Catch The Snacks
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Slide a shopping cart beneath the falling snacks in Catch The Snacks. Follow the wish list and leave the wrong items alone while you try to score within 60 seconds.

pages.title: Besties Ordinary Funky Makeover
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Give Emma, Mia and Sophie fresh looks in Besties Ordinary Funky Makeover. Pick clothes and makeover details for each friend and decide how far to take the funky style.

pages.title: Queen Fashion Salon Royal Dress Up
pages.creator: DESIGN GAMES INC
pages.description: Put together outfits for a queen in Queen Fashion Salon Royal Dress Up. Try different pieces and accessories to suit the look you want for her time away from official duties.

pages.title: Slimoban 2
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Explore dungeons full of slimes in Slimoban 2. Move blocks to solve Sokoban-style puzzles, avoid the creatures and collect the golden coin you need to finish each level.

pages.title: Princess Punk Fashion
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description: Try a different style for Elsa, Ariel and Belle in Princess Punk Fashion. Choose punk outfits and accessories for the princesses and see how the look changes on each one.

pages.title: Christmas Snowman Jigsaw Puzzle
pages.creator: GamesFine.com
pages.description: Rebuild twelve winter scenes in Christmas Snowman Jigsaw Puzzle by dragging pieces into place. Pick a small grid for a quick solve or try a larger one for more pieces.

pages.title: Call to Action Multiplayer
pages.creator: G55.CO
pages.description: Enter a deathmatch against other players in Call to Action Multiplayer. Choose from modern firearms and use each map's layout to find cover and angles on your rivals.

pages.title: Dino Fossil
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Compare a fossil with the dinosaurs shown in Dino Fossil. Look at the shape of the bones and select the animal you think left those remains.

pages.title: The Angler
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Go fishing from a boat in The Angler. Watch the fish below and time the line to catch one, then try again as another target swims into reach.

pages.title: Dino Fun Adventure
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Guide a dinosaur through three platforming stages in Dino Fun Adventure. Collect small eggs for points and track down all three golden eggs in each area before you move on.

pages.title: Power Light
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Rotate wire sections in Power Light until they carry power from the battery to the bulb. Follow the connections across the board and fix any breaks that keep the light off.

pages.title: Geometrical Dash
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Guide a square through tight obstacle courses in Geometrical Dash. Tap or press the space bar to jump, timing each move to fit the gaps in the route.

pages.title: Dice Gang
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Recruit dice characters and build a gang in Dice Gang. Move around the map looking for new members and take on other groups when your team is strong enough.

pages.title: Dragon Slayer FPS
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Pick up weapons in Dragon Slayer FPS and fight to survive in the land of the bone dragon. Watch for skeletons as you move and change weapons to suit the enemies you face.

pages.title: Fun Planes Jigsaw
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Pick from twelve aircraft pictures in Fun Planes Jigsaw and rebuild one from scattered pieces. Choose 25, 49 or 100 pieces depending on how long you want the puzzle to take.

pages.title: Cartoon Giraffe Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Put together cartoon giraffe pictures in Cartoon Giraffe Puzzle. Choose from six scenes and work at the piece count you prefer, from 16 up to 100.

pages.title: Monster Truck Stunts
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Take a monster truck across 30 courses in Monster Truck Stunts. Manage its balance over obstacles and try tricks when there is enough space to land safely.

pages.title: Epic Race
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Race other players through a 3D obstacle course in Epic Race. Read the obstacles ahead and time your runs through openings to stay in the race and move ahead.

pages.title: Tank VS Undead
pages.creator: Arcade Lemon
pages.description: Move a tank into position in Tank VS Undead and fire at the approaching enemies. Keep clearing targets as they come into range so the undead don't overwhelm you.

pages.title: Happy Rabbits
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Open the rabbits' mouths to catch food in Happy Rabbits. Keep them ready for the next bite but close up when a bomb comes instead of something to eat.

pages.title: Baby Halen Cook Style
pages.creator: JZJO.COM
pages.description: Pick a kitchen outfit for Baby Halen in Baby Halen Cook Style. Try different clothes and accessories to get her ready to cook for guests at home.

pages.title: Save the Giraffe
pages.creator: NA
pages.description: Steer the giraffe away from falling blades in Save the Giraffe. Watch where each blade is about to land and move left or right to stay out of its path.

pages.title: Cubes King
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Drop blocks onto the board in Cubes King and try to build higher than the other stacks. Choose each release carefully so the blocks land where they'll help you most.

pages.title: Christmas Gravity Tree
pages.creator: Onduck Games
pages.description: Run as a Christmas tree in Christmas Gravity Tree and tap to reverse gravity. Switch surfaces when something blocks the path and see how far you can make it through the course.

pages.title: Fury Road Rampage
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Shoot enemies on the road and in the air in Fury Road Rampage. Keep moving as attacks come from different directions and try to survive long enough to build a high score.

pages.title: Marvelous Hot Wheels : Stunt Car Racing Game
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Drive fast and take on stunt routes in Marvelous Hot Wheels : Stunt Car Racing Game. Control the car through each jump and turn while you try to beat the other drivers.

pages.title: Basket Champs
pages.creator: RavalMatic
pages.description: Aim free throws in Basket Champs and compete in a basketball tournament. Read how the shot is set up before releasing the ball and try to outscore each opponent.

pages.title: Trivia King
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Answer quick questions in Trivia King and compare results with friends. Test what you know about general topics and pop culture as you race through each quiz round.

pages.title: BTS Panda Coloring
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Choose a panda picture in BTS Panda Coloring and fill it in with your own palette. Try different shades on the animal and the other details in the drawing.

pages.title: Sheep Fight
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Send sheep down farm lanes in Sheep Fight to push back your opponent. Watch where the other flock is strongest and choose which type of sheep to deploy in each lane.

pages.title: Perfect Turn
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Turn a sponge around the floor in Perfect Turn to paint the whole area. Plan the route around corners so that the sponge can reach squares you would otherwise leave bare.

pages.title: Knife Skill
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Throw knives into a spinning board in Knife Skill. Wait for a clear gap between blades already stuck in it, and aim for apples when you can get extra points.

pages.title: Wording
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Connect letters to make words in Wording. Try different arrangements of the letters you have and use the words you recognize to work through the spelling puzzles.

pages.title: Stack Ball Fall 3D
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Drive a falling ball through colored layers in Stack Ball Fall 3D. Time your descent around the rotating platforms and avoid hitting the sections that can stop the run.

pages.title: Mine Clone 4
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Build and reshape a block world in Mine Clone 4. Use the mouse to add or remove blocks and open your inventory to choose the materials for your next construction.

pages.title: Super Happy Kitty
pages.creator: igirlgames
pages.description: Give the kitten a bath in Super Happy Kitty, then keep it company after it gets clean. Offer it food and use the toys to play with it.

pages.title: Little Girl Superhero Vs Princess
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Try both superhero and princess outfits in Little Girl Superhero Vs Princess. Put together a costume for each idea and help the birthday girl decide which one she wants to wear.

pages.title: Fire Trucks Puzzle
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Piece together images of fire engines in Fire Trucks Puzzle. Pick a picture and use the truck's shape and details to work out how the jigsaw pieces fit together.

pages.title: Whack a Craft
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: React to quick challenges in Whack a Craft. Earn enough points to finish the first twenty games and open another set of twenty tests for your reflexes.

pages.title: Halloween Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Choose a spooky drawing in Halloween Coloring Book and color it with the shades you like. Give each Halloween picture its own look by changing the colors of its details.

pages.title: Wrestling
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Fight a succession of opponents in Wrestling. Watch where the next wrestler is coming from and react as they get close to keep the fight going.

pages.title: Whose House
pages.creator: TapLabGames
pages.description: Match creatures with the places they live in Whose House. Look over the pictures and pick the home that fits the animal or character shown for each question.

pages.title: Slime Hunter
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Shoot the slimes as they come into range in Slime Hunter. Keep moving as they close in and look for openings to take down more of them.

pages.title: Blast Mania
pages.creator: JoyBits
pages.description: Link matching pieces in Blast Mania and clear them in chains. Look over the colored elements to find long connections that can help you work through the puzzle.

pages.title: Blox Shock!
pages.creator: Star Mill B.V.
pages.description: Drop block shapes onto the board in Blox Shock! Fit them together to clear lines and think about where the next pieces could go before using up the open spaces.

pages.title: Color Blocks
pages.creator: Super Games
pages.description: Fit colored blocks together in Color Blocks. Arrange the pieces so they work with the spaces on the board and try to leave room for the shapes that follow.

pages.title: Duck Hunter autumn forest
pages.creator: Playcombo
pages.description: Aim at ducks in the autumn woods in Duck Hunter autumn forest. Track the birds as they move across the scene and wait until you have a clear shot.

pages.title: Valentines Spot the Difference
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Compare two Valentine pictures in Valentines Spot the Difference. Find all five changes and click them on the right-hand image to open the next pair of pictures.

pages.title: ChristmasRoom Decoration
pages.creator: dreamgamestudio@gmail.com
pages.description: Decorate a living room and a bedroom in ChristmasRoom Decoration. Choose where to place the tree and other seasonal items to get both rooms ready for Christmas.

pages.title: Halloween_Wheel
pages.creator: Ixel Games
pages.description: Balance a pumpkin on a unicycle in Halloween_Wheel. Adjust as the wheel tilts and see how far you can travel before gravity brings your ride to an end.

pages.title: Pac Bird
pages.creator: Cosmity
pages.description: Fly up and down to eat popcorn in Pac Bird. Watch for fireballs entering from the sides and keep changing your height to reach more popcorn without getting hit.

pages.title: Geek Fashion Girl
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Help the doll get ready in Geek Fashion Girl. Start with her beauty treatments, then try makeup and clothing choices to put together the fashion look you want.

pages.title: Puzzle Blocks
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Fit every block into the board in Puzzle Blocks. Think about where the larger shapes belong first, then use the remaining pieces to fill the empty areas.

pages.title: Back to Candyland Episode 3: Sweet River
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Clear candy groups as you sail toward a mysterious island in Back to Candyland Episode 3: Sweet River. Look for matches that help with each level's goal before you move downstream.

pages.title: Mermaid Princess Glossy Makeup
pages.creator: DariaGames.com
pages.description: Create a glossy look for a mermaid in Mermaid Princess Glossy Makeup. Try shades of blush, lipstick and eyeshadow, then use mascara and other products to finish the look.
